entities.name: EAP-success message
entities.description: EAP success message sent by AUSF/AAA server upon successful EAP authentication procedure completion

entities.name: EAP-response/AKA'-notification message
entities.description: EAP response message that triggers the sending of EAP-success message

entities.name: EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message
entities.description: EAP challenge message whose successful handling precedes EAP-success transmission

entities.name: AUSF
entities.description: Authentication Server Function that sends EAP-success and provides KSEAF to SEAF

entities.name: AAA server
entities.description: AAA server in CH or DCS that can send EAP-success message

entities.name: Successful EAP-request/AKA'-challenge handling
entities.description: Condition where earlier procedures for handling EAP-request/AKA'-challenge message were successful

entities.name: Procedure complete
entities.description: State where the authentication procedure is considered complete after EAP-success transmission

relations.description: Reception of EAP-response/AKA'-notification triggers evaluation of EAP-success condition
Successful EAP-request/AKA'-challenge handling condition guards the sending of EAP-success message
AUSF sends EAP-success message when conditions are met
AAA server sends EAP-success message when conditions are met
Sending EAP-success message establishes that the procedure is complete
